procedure.name: NewOrder
procedure.statement: SELECT C_DISCOUNT, C_LAST, C_CREDIT FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT D_NEXT_O_ID, D_TAX FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?
SELECT S_QUANTITY, S_DATA, S_DIST_01, S_DIST_02, S_DIST_03, S_DIST_04, S_DIST_05, S_DIST_06, S_DIST_07, S_DIST_08, S_DIST_09, S_DIST_10 FROM STOCK WHERE S_W_I_KEY = ?
UPDATE DISTRICT SET D_NEXT_O_ID = D_NEXT_O_ID + 1 WHERE D_KEY = ?
INSERT INTO NEW_ORDER (NO_O_ID, NO_D_ID, NO_W_ID, NO_KEY) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO OORDER (O_ID, O_D_ID, O_W_ID, O_C_ID, O_ENTRY_D, O_OL_CNT, O_ALL_LOCAL, O_KEY, O_C_KEY) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE STOCK SET S_QUANTITY = ? , S_YTD = S_YTD + ?, S_ORDER_CNT = S_ORDER_CNT + 1, S_REMOTE_CNT = S_REMOTE_CNT + ? WHERE S_W_I_KEY = ?
INSERT INTO ORDER_LINE (OL_O_ID, OL_D_ID, OL_W_ID, OL_NUMBER, OL_I_ID, OL_SUPPLY_W_ID, OL_QUANTITY, OL_AMOUNT, OL_DIST_INFO, OL_O_KEY, OL_W_I_KEY) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

procedure.name: Payment
procedure.statement: UPDATE DISTRICT SET D_YTD = D_YTD + ? WHERE D_KEY = ?
SELECT D_STREET_1, D_STREET_2, D_CITY, D_STATE, D_ZIP, D_NAME FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?

SELECT C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_LAST, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT C_DATA FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
UPDATE CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = ?, C_YTD_PAYMENT = ?, C_PAYMENT_CNT = ?, C_DATA = ? WHERE C_KEY = ?
UPDATE CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = ?, C_YTD_PAYMENT = ?, C_PAYMENT_CNT = ? WHERE C_KEY = ?
INSERT INTO HISTORY (H_C_D_ID, H_C_W_ID, H_C_ID, H_D_ID, H_W_ID, H_DATE, H_AMOUNT, H_DATA, H_C_KEY) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_ID, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_W_D_LAST_FIRST BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY C_FIRST

procedure.name: OrderStatus
procedure.statement: SELECT C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_LAST, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_KEY = ?
SELECT O_ID, O_CARRIER_ID, O_ENTRY_D FROM OORDER WHERE O_C_KEY = ? ORDER BY O_KEY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT OL_I_ID, OL_SUPPLY_W_ID, OL_QUANTITY, OL_AMOUNT, OL_DELIVERY_D FROM ORDER_LINE WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?

SELECT C_FIRST, C_MIDDLE, C_ID, C_STREET_1, C_STREET_2, C_CITY, C_STATE, C_ZIP, C_PHONE, C_CREDIT, C_CREDIT_LIM, C_DISCOUNT, C_BALANCE, C_YTD_PAYMENT, C_PAYMENT_CNT, C_SINCE FROM CUSTOMER WHERE C_W_D_LAST_FIRST BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY C_FIRST

procedure.name: Delivery
procedure.statement: SELECT NO_O_ID FROM NEW_ORDER WHERE NO_KEY BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY NO_KEY ASC LIMIT 1
DELETE FROM NEW_ORDER WHERE NO_KEY = ?
SELECT O_C_ID FROM OORDER WHERE O_KEY = ?
UPDATE OORDER SET O_CARRIER_ID = ? WHERE O_KEY = ?
UPDATE ORDER_LINE SET OL_DELIVERY_D = ? WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?
SELECT SUM(OL_AMOUNT) AS OL_TOTAL FROM ORDER_LINE WHERE OL_O_KEY = ?
UPDATE CUSTOMER SET C_BALANCE = C_BALANCE + ?, C_DELIVERY_CNT = C_DELIVERY_CNT + 1 WHERE C_KEY = ?

procedure.name: StockLevel
procedure.statement: SELECT D_NEXT_O_ID FROM DISTRICT WHERE D_KEY = ?
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (S_I_ID)) AS STOCK_COUNT FROM ORDER_LINE, STOCK WHERE OL_O_KEY < ? AND OL_O_KEY >= ? AND OL_W_I_KEY = S_W_I_KEY AND S_QUANTITY < ?
